verdict: Paid ads are efficient; Google Business and site traffic need attention now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.74 for every $1 spent on $1,481.68 in total ad spend — and that efficiency held virtually flat even as spend dipped 7.1% last week, which is a genuine positive signal. Purchases jumped 57% week-over-week through mid-period, though the final three days (Sep 21–23) showed a softer pace that we are watching closely. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile went dark over those same three days — zero actions on Sep 22 and Sep 23 against a 28-day daily average of roughly 23 — and website sessions are down 22% week-over-week; we are actively investigating the cause. Several planned milestones from August are also being brought back on track as a priority heading into the September 30 deadline.

watch_item.issue: Your Google Business Profile recorded zero actions on Sep 22 and Sep 23 — a sudden drop from the normal daily average of ~23 — with website traffic softening in the same window.
watch_item.fix: We are investigating the root cause now and will have a clear answer before next week's report; no paid changes are suspected.
